sections.label: Tagline
sections.content: Highly customizable and flexible 'building block' approach to workspace creation, allowing users to integrate notes, databases, project tracking, wikis, and more into a single, adaptable environment, now complemented by integrated calendar and mail applications.

sections.label: Description
sections.content: Notion Labs offers an all-in-one workspace application designed for notes, tasks, wikis, and databases, enabling individuals and teams to customize their workflow for enhanced productivity. It also provides integrated calendar and email solutions.

sections.label: Core capabilities
sections.content:
Notion (collaborative workspace)
Notion Calendar
Notion Mail

sections.label: Pricing
sections.content: Freemium (personal use), subscription-based tiers (Plus, Business, Enterprise) with varying features and user limits.

sections.label: Target industry
sections.content: Individuals, small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs), startups, educational institutions, and enterprises seeking flexible project management, knowledge management, and productivity solutions.
